content: Hello everyone, I am a student of engineering and need some help to get started with lean. As a first step I like to do some proofs of my linear algebra book. However I do not know how to start. My book starts with an explanation of a system of linear equations and how to solve them with matrices and vectors. Or is there a definition of a matrix etc in the library? Or should I try to rewrite the definitions in lean?
Note that matrix is just a curried binary function.

I should warn you that formalizing proofs based on Gaussian elimination (which are typical for understaduate textbooks) is somewhat difficult. One possible place is start is our library:
https://github.com/Ivan-Sergeyev/seymour/blob/main/Seymour/Matrix/Pivoting.lean
Thanks for the warning, I think it really is a bit too difficult for me to do program the Gaussian elimination at the moment but I saved your GitHub library for later.
